## 1. Sample

- [ ] 1.1 Add the new marker to the sample file
  Files: src/sample.txt
  Do: Append the line `New marker is present` to src/sample.txt.
  Done-when: src/sample.txt contains the line `New marker is present`.

- [ ] 1.2 Create the second sample file
  Files: new file: src/second.txt
  Do: Create src/second.txt with the single line `Second marker`.
  Done-when: src/second.txt exists and contains the line `Second marker`.
